commitments.detail: All 720 housings will be reworked to ensure they meet the required specifications.
All 720 housings will be reworked at 850°C for 60 minutes, followed by 100% hardness testing.
All 720 housings will be reworked at 850°C for 60 minutes and then subjected to 100% hardness testing.
All 720 housings will undergo reprocessing at 850°C for 60 minutes.
After rework, all 720 housings will be subjected to a 100% hardness test.
Process records and disposition documentation will be retained for 5 years.
